paras: Enhance the stance and precision of your BMW M2 (G87) , M3 (G80/G81) , or M4 (G82/G83) with AST Adjustable Lowering Springs. This system is designed specifically for M-models equipped with Electronic Damping Control (EDC) , allowing you to customise your ride height while retaining the full functionality of your factory adaptive suspension and drive modes.

By using the adjusters on the original EDC dampers, you can achieve an aggressive, lower centre of gravity. This reduces body roll and sharpens steering response, making it an essential upgrade for both road and track use. Every kit is 100% made in the Netherlands to ensure premium quality and long-term durability for high-performance applications.
